impact.formula: Data rows (not quotes): Otezla MFP 1,650 per 30 days, 28.57 per unit for the main NDC, effective 01/01/2027 (data/external/ira_selected_drugs_mfp.zip); Otezla Part D 2024 gross 1,045M on 12.95M units = 80.68 per unit (data/external/partd_spending_dy24.csv) -> MFP is 65% below. Base 2027 Otezla net-price hit = 25% x (0.62 / 0.98) = 15.8% x 2025 US Otezla 1,839M = 288M (assumption: Enbrel H1 2026 effect scales with exposure; it also includes 340B mix). peer.note: Enbrel is the in-house precedent: its Medicare price took US Enbrel from 3,288M (2024) to 2,199M (2025) and a further 19% down in H1 2026 (10-K p. 66, 10-Q p. 35).
